TYPE CHECK: The candidate value is a species name, which matches the field definition.
SOURCE CHECK: The candidate value "Homo sapiens" is not the source of the MS sample; the paper states the antibody "Mannitou" is a "murine IgM" (mouse) and the recombinant Fab was produced in "HEK293 FreeStyle cells" (human cell line).
TRUTH CHECK: The MS sample is the recombinant Mannitou Fab. While produced in human cells, the protein itself is a murine antibody fragment. More importantly, the "species" field refers to the source organism of the biological material. In the context of a recombinant protein produced in a cell line, the species of the protein (mouse) or the species of the expression system (human) could be argued, but the candidate "Homo sapiens" refers to the expression host, not the origin of the antibody being studied. However, the text explicitly identifies Mannitou as a "murine IgM".
COMPLETENESS CHECK: The full set contains only "Homo sapiens", which is incorrect as it ignores the murine origin of the antibody.
